dial-inbound-retry.offlineTranscript: Sorry, that Agent Pering Code did not connect. Say all 12 digits, then pause, or enter all 12 digits on your keypad and press star.

dial-inbound.offlineTranscript: Please enter or say your 12 digit agent pairing code. If you enter it on your keypad, press star when you're done.

dial-repeat.offlineTranscript: Welcome back. I've sent a secure verification request to your trusted device. Confirm it with FaceID, TouchID, or your Pasquite to continue. To use a new aged pairing code instead, press hash.
